Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

RGraphSpace 1.5.7

  • Edge glyphs, node offsets and edge labels are computed at draw time
  • Mutual directed edges are drawn as two separate arrows

RGraphSpace 1.5.6

  • Addressed additional issues identified during the JOSS review
  • Added support for glyph-based arrow types and expanded unit tests
  • Removed unnecessary \dontrun{} from examples
  • Added runnable examples for all user-facing functions
  • Argument validation and all errors are signaled through rlang

RGraphSpace 1.5.5

  • Improved the geometry accessors and interface
  • Improved documentation and expanded unit tests

RGraphSpace 1.5.4

  • Addressed issues identified during the JOSS review
  • Added a GitHub workflow running ‘R CMD check’
  • Improved documentation, codebase, and unit tests

RGraphSpace 1.5.3

  • Implement support for SpatRaster image

RGraphSpace 1.5.2

CRAN release: 2026-08-24

  • Restored compatibility with objects from older package versions
  • Improved compatibility with non-linear coordinate systems
  • Implement support for sf geometry
  • Implement rotate, flip, and transpose helpers
  • Improved subset, crop, and coordinate normalization

RGraphSpace 1.5.0

CRAN release: 2026-07-23

  • Improved compatibility with igraph and tidygraph objects
  • Added support for graphs with multiple edges and self-loops
  • Added replacement and subsetting accessors
  • Refactored the internal codebase

RGraphSpace 1.4.1

CRAN release: 2026-06-24

  • Restored compatibility with objects from older package versions

RGraphSpace 1.4.0

CRAN release: 2026-06-13

  • Improved integration with ggplot2 ecosystem
  • Added accessors and annotation functions for spatial data analysis

RGraphSpace 1.3.0

CRAN release: 2026-05-22

  • Major updates to package vignettes and online documentation
  • Enhanced coordinate mapping functions for ggplot2 geoms
  • Improved integration with ggplot2 ecosystem

RGraphSpace 1.2.0

CRAN release: 2026-04-25

  • Major compatibility improvements with ggplot2 geoms

RGraphSpace 1.1.1

CRAN release: 2026-02-28

  • Codebase improvements and maintenance updates
